query_templates: SELECT DISTINCT b.oid, b.main_id, b.ra, b.dec, b.otype_txt, f.V, b.galdim_majaxis, b.galdim_minaxis, b.galdim_angle FROM basic AS b JOIN ident AS i ON i.oidref = b.oid LEFT OUTER JOIN allfluxes AS f ON f.oidref = b.oid WHERE i.id LIKE '{like}' AND b.ra IS NOT NULL AND b.dec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY oid

SELECT DISTINCT b.oid, b.main_id, b.ra, b.dec, b.otype_txt, f.V, b.galdim_majaxis, b.galdim_minaxis, b.galdim_angle, i.id FROM basic AS b JOIN ident AS i ON i.oidref = b.oid LEFT OUTER JOIN allfluxes AS f ON f.oidref = b.oid WHERE i.id IN ({ids}) AND b.ra IS NOT NULL AND b.dec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY oid, id
SELECT i.oidref, i.id FROM ident AS i WHERE i.oidref IN ({oids})
